verdict.rationale: The evidence documents no API at all, let alone one that matches the UI. The only machine-oriented paths are an XML schema package for large-file reemployment-tax submissions and a batch enrollment file whose specs are available only by email request. These are bulk file formats adjacent to an API, not a programmatic interface. The probe shows registration and tax transactions sit behind an interactive authenticated login shell.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
